nodes.description: Caller-supplied address used for authorization, ownership, transfers and balance accounting across the protocol.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for interest accrual, last-update bookkeeping and event metadata.
Mutex counter used by the nonReentrant modifier; incremented without overflow check.
Owner address controlling onlyOwner-guarded administrative functions.
Protocol component registry mapping bytes32 keys to implementation/proxy addresses.
Token balance ledger mutated by transfer/mint/burn.
ERC20 allowance ledger used by transferFrom and allowance mutations.
Per-user normalized income index used to compute accrued interest.
Per-user redirected balance that accrues interest for the target address.
Underlying reserve asset backing the aToken; drives core lookups.
Mapping of reserve address to ReserveData (rates, indexes, config flags).
Per-user per-reserve borrow/collateral accounting struct.
Reference to the LendingPoolCore contract that holds funds and state.
Reference to the data provider used for health factor and balance calculations.
Registry used to resolve all protocol component addresses.
EIP-1967 storage slot holding the implementation address, written via assembly.
EIP-1967 storage slot holding the proxy admin address, written via assembly.
Flashloan fee in basis points (35) used to compute amountFee and protocolFee.
Mutex modifier guarding state-changing LendingPool entry points; increases _guardCounter unchecked.
Transfers contract ownership to newOwner; guarded by onlyOwner.
Deposits underlying asset, mints aTokens and moves funds into the core.
Redeems underlying for a user, callable only by the reserve aToken.
Borrows reserve currency after collateral/health factor validation.
Repays a borrow, optionally on behalf of another user; routes fees and principal.
Swaps between stable and variable borrow rate modes.
Rebalances a user's stable borrow rate when conditions are met.
Enables/disables a deposit as collateral after balance decrease check.
Delegates liquidation logic to the liquidation manager via delegatecall.
Transfers liquidity to a receiver, invokes executeOperation callback, then verifies repayment.
Transfers reserve tokens or raw ETH to a user; onlyLendingPool.
Pulls tokens/ETH into the reserve and refunds excess ETH via low-level call.
Sends repay fees to the token distributor; uses low-level ETH call when ETH.
Transfers liquidated fees to the destination; uses low-level ETH call when ETH.
Compounds flashloan income into the liquidity index and refreshes interest rates.
Updates reserve and user borrow state on a borrow action.
Executes liquidation logic in delegatecall context; moves collateral and fees.
Burns aTokens and requests underlying redemption from the LendingPool.
Mints aTokens on deposit; onlyLendingPool.
Burns aTokens during liquidation; onlyLendingPool.
Transfers aTokens to the liquidator; onlyLendingPool.
Overridden ERC20 transfer that enforces transfer allowance and interest accounting.
Redirects the caller's accrued interest to a target address.
Redirects another user's interest stream relying on a stored allowance.
Grants an address permission to redirect the caller's interest.
Mints accrued interest into the principal and refreshes the user index.
Updates redirected balances of redirection targets, cascading updates.
Performs low-level call to token and validates optional return data.
Upgrades implementation and delegatecalls arbitrary init data; ifAdmin-guarded.
Changes proxy admin; ifAdmin-guarded.
Initializes implementation and delegatecalls user-supplied init data; unguarded once.
Initializes implementation, admin and init data for the proxy.
Assembly delegatecall forwarding calldata to the implementation.
Fallback entry that delegates all calls to the implementation.
Deploys or upgrades component proxies and re-initializes them with this contract.
Owner-only updater of the lending pool implementation address.
Linear interest formula driven by block.timestamp and last update.
Compounded interest formula using rayPow and block.timestamp delta.
Writes the implementation address into the EIP-1967 slot via assembly sstore.
Writes the admin address into the EIP-1967 slot via assembly sstore.
abi.encodeWithSignature delegatecall to the liquidation manager address from the registry.
delegatecall to a freshly supplied implementation with arbitrary data in upgradeToAndCall.
delegatecall of caller-supplied _data during proxy initialization.
_user.call.value(amount).gas(50000)("") sending raw ETH to an arbitrary address.
address(token).call(data) low-level token call with optional return decoding.
External call into attacker-controlled IFlashLoanReceiver.executeOperation before repayment check.
Assembly sstore to IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT without access-control on the raw write path.
Assembly sstore to ADMIN_SLOT writing the proxy admin.
_guardCounter += 1 executed without SafeMath; overflow would defeat the mutex.
uint40(block.timestamp) truncation when persisting lastUpdateTimestamp.
_user.call.value(excessAmount).gas(50000)("") refunding overpaid ETH.
feeAddress.call.value(amount).gas(50000)("") sending ETH fees to a destination.
Assembly delegatecall(gas, implementation, ...) forwarding all calldata and value.
feeAddress.call.value(amount).gas(50000)("") sending liquidated fees as ETH.
_reserve parameter of LendingPool.deposit selecting the target reserve.
_amount parameter of LendingPool.deposit controlling the deposited quantity.
_amount parameter of LendingPool.borrow controlling the borrowed quantity.
_receiver parameter of flashLoan; arbitrary contract invoked as callback.
_amount parameter of flashLoan controlling funds transferred out.
_amount parameter of LendingPool.repay, or UINT_MAX_VALUE to repay all.
_onBehalfOf parameter of repay selecting whose debt is reduced.
_user parameter of liquidationCall identifying the borrower being liquidated.
_purchaseAmount parameter bounding how much principal the liquidator repays.
_user payable destination of the ETH/token payout in transferToUser.
_amount transferred to the user by transferToUser.
_amount parameter of AToken.redeem; UINT_MAX_VALUE means redeem all.
newOwner parameter of Ownable.transferOwnership.
newImplementation address that becomes the delegatecall target.
user-supplied calldata delegatecalled on the new implementation.
_logic implementation address set during proxy initialization.
_data delegatecalled against _logic during proxy initialization.
encoded call data forwarded to the token address by callOptionalReturn.
Computed flashloan fee: _amount * totalFeeBips / 10000.
Portion of amountFee routed to the protocol: amountFee * protocolFeeBips / 10000.
Snapshot of _guardCounter compared after the guarded body executes.
Accrued interest delta minted as new principal in cumulateBalanceInternal.
BorrowLocalVars memory struct holding borrow amounts, LTV and health factor flags.
msg.value - _amount refunded back to the payer with a low-level call.
LiquidationCallLocalVars memory struct holding collateral and fee computations.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the depositor whose aToken balance and funds are used in deposit.
msg.sender is the borrower for whom global data and collateral checks are computed.
msg.sender determines the liquidator and is passed implicitly to the delegatecalled manager.
msg.sender must equal the lending pool before ETH is pushed out to an arbitrary user.
msg.sender must equal the lending pool before reserve funds are pulled and ETH refunded.
In delegatecall context msg.sender is the liquidator receiving aTokens or underlying.
AToken._transfer validates the sender's balance decrease before moving balances.
redirectInterestStream uses msg.sender as the interest owner.
allowInterestRedirectionTo writes an allowance keyed by msg.sender.
transferOwnership must be called by the current owner via onlyOwner.
changeAdmin executes the body only when msg.sender equals the stored admin.
upgradeToAndCall is gated by the ifAdmin modifier comparing msg.sender with the admin slot.
setLendingPoolImpl is protected by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to _owner.
calculateLinearInterest derives timeDifference from block.timestamp, making accrual miner-influenced.
calculateCompoundedInterest bases rayPow exponent on block.timestamp difference.
block.timestamp is truncated to uint40 before being stored as lastUpdateTimestamp.
deposit calls core.transferToReserve.value(msg.value) to move the deposit into the core.
deposit calls aToken.mintOnDeposit to mint the corresponding aTokens.
flashLoan invokes receiver.executeOperation before verifying the returned balance.
flashLoan pushes funds to the receiver via core.transferToUser before the callback.
State is updated only after the untrusted callback returns, coupling callback and accounting.
flashLoan finalizes accounting via core.updateStateOnFlashLoan.
amountFee is split into protocol income and depositor income passed to the core.
protocolFee is derived from amountFee by a basis-point multiplication.
liquidationCall builds calldata and delegatecalls the liquidation manager.
The delegatecall executes the manager's liquidation logic in the pool's storage context.
Liquidation transfers aTokens to the liquidator when _receiveAToken is true.
Liquidation burns the borrower's aTokens when underlying is paid out.
Liquidation moves underlying collateral to msg.sender via core.transferToUser.
Liquidation routes liquidated origination fees through core.liquidateFee.
AToken.redeem calls pool.redeemUnderlying which pushes underlying back to the user.
redeemUnderlying moves the redeemed amount out through core.transferToUser.
ETH reserves are sent with a raw call to _user with a 50000 gas stipend.
ERC20 reserves are sent via SafeERC20.safeTransfer which routes to callOptionalReturn.
Overpaid ETH is refunded to the user with a low-level call.
Token deposits are pulled through SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom.
ETH fees are forwarded to the destination with a low-level call.
Liquidated ETH fees are forwarded to the destination with a low-level call.
callOptionalReturn performs the raw token call and decodes the optional boolean.
Encoded calldata including token recipient/amount is executed against the token address.
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls the caller-supplied data on the new implementation.
newImplementation becomes the delegatecall target and is written to storage.
data is executed verbatim in the proxy's storage context.
initialize delegatecalls _data against the newly set _logic address.
_logic is stored as the implementation and then used as the delegatecall target.
_data is executed during initialization, allowing arbitrary storage writes.
InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize chains into the base initializer.
_setImplementation writes the implementation with assembly sstore.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is the storage slot written by the assembly sstore.
_setAdmin writes the proxy admin with assembly sstore.
ADMIN_SLOT is the storage slot written by the assembly sstore.
_delegate performs the assembly delegatecall forwarding all calldata and value.
_fallback routes every unmatched call into _delegate.
The mutex performs _guardCounter += 1 without SafeMath.
_guardCounter is the storage variable mutated by the unchecked increment.
localCounter snapshots the value and is compared to detect reentrancy.
transferOwnership rewrites the privileged _owner storage variable.
setLendingPoolImpl performs the upgrade through updateImplInternal.
updateImplInternal deploys and initializes a new upgradeable proxy when none exists.
updateImplInternal upgrades an existing proxy with upgradeToAndCall and init params.
updateImplInternal reads and writes the component registry mapping.
updateStateOnBorrow mutates per-user borrow balances and timestamps.
updateStateOnBorrow mutates reserve totals and cumulative indexes.
updateStateOnFlashLoan compounds income into the reserve liquidity index.
borrow finalizes state through core.updateStateOnBorrow.
borrow pushes the borrowed amount to the borrower after state update.
repay forwards origination fees to the distributor via a low-level-capable transfer.
repay sends principal into the core and may refund excess ETH.
cumulateBalanceInternal queries the core for normalized income.
cumulateBalanceInternal stores the refreshed user index.
updateRedirectedBalanceOfRedirectionAddressInternal mutates redirected balances.
Redirection updates compound the target address before adjusting balances.
AToken._transfer updates redirected balances of both parties after transferring.
transferOnLiquidation reuses executeTransferInternal/_transfer accounting.
redeem adjusts the redirected balance of the caller's redirection target.
redirectInterestStreamOf delegates to redirectInterestStreamInternal after allowance check.
The reserve argument selects the aToken and core calls performed by deposit.
The deposit amount is minted and transferred into the core.
The borrow amount drives liquidity, fee and collateral-needed computations.
The receiver address is cast to IFlashLoanReceiver and invoked as a callback.
The flashloan amount is transferred out and used for fee computation.
The repay amount bounds the payback and is compared with UINT_MAX_VALUE.
_onBehalfOf selects whose debt is reduced and whose fee is paid.
The borrower address is forwarded into the delegatecalled liquidation calldata.
The purchase amount is forwarded into the delegatecalled liquidation calldata.
The payable destination is the target of the raw ETH call.
The payout amount is embedded in the token transfer or ETH call value.
The redeem amount is capped to the current balance when UINT_MAX_VALUE is passed.
newOwner becomes the new privileged _owner after validation.
derived fee flows
The accrued interest delta is minted as new aToken principal.
BorrowLocalVars holds intermediate amounts, LTV and health factor flags for borrow.
excessAmount is computed from msg.value and refunded via the raw call.
LiquidationCallLocalVars holds all computed liquidation amounts and flags.

normalization_plan.reason: Reserve selector parameter is only meaningful as an argument to LendingPool.deposit.
Deposit amount parameter flows directly into deposit's mint and transfer calls.
Borrow amount parameter only feeds LendingPool.borrow liquidity and fee checks.
Receiver parameter is bound to the flashLoan external callback invocation.
Flashloan amount parameter is consumed by flashLoan's transfer and fee math.
Repay amount parameter is consumed by LendingPool.repay payback logic.
_onBehalfOf parameter is consumed by repay state updates and fee transfers.
Liquidated user parameter only feeds the liquidationCall delegatecall payload.
Purchase amount parameter only feeds the liquidationCall delegatecall payload.
Recipient parameter is the target of transferToUser's raw ETH call.
Amount parameter is the value forwarded by transferToUser.
Redeem amount parameter is consumed only by AToken.redeem.
newOwner parameter is written to _owner by transferOwnership.
newImplementation feeds the unsafe delegatecall target in upgradeToAndCall.
data is the exact payload executed in the unsafe delegatecall.
_logic becomes the delegatecall target during proxy initialization.
_data is executed in the unsafe initialization delegatecall.
Encoded data is the payload of the low-level token call in callOptionalReturn.
amountFee local is passed to updateStateOnFlashLoan for index compounding.
protocolFee local is passed to updateStateOnFlashLoan for fee distribution.
localCounter local exists only to compare against the unchecked guard increment.
balanceIncrease local is minted as principal by mintOnDeposit.
BorrowLocalVars struct is a local aggregate used only inside LendingPool.borrow.
excessAmount local is the value used in the refund low-level call.
LiquidationCallLocalVars struct is local to the liquidation manager logic.
